scope: Page geometry, measurement, dynamic surface/control sizing, window-capability layout, motion registration (including non-ArkUI clocks), message windows, and reduceMotion ownership for the structural porting baseline. The Harmony-native animation worktree is excluded. This is not a whole-app or whole-repository baseline.

baseline.commitSubject: docs: consolidate committed cross-platform UI reference
baseline.reason: The structural/UI consolidation is uncommitted and the tree is being changed by parallel work. File SHA-256 fingerprints below define this provisional snapshot; the commit alone does not.

portingBaseline.role: Structural/UI optimization route and the source of truth for other platforms.
portingBaseline.allowedWork: Structure, geometry ownership, and non-Harmony-specific UI adaptation.

harmonyMotionWorktree.allowedWork: Effect-only development. Do not merge its BookshelfShell, SearchPage, Index, or scaffold copies wholesale.
harmonyMotionWorktree.integrationRule: Rebase completed effects onto the baseline and consume baseline geometry; effects must not own header height, history viewport, results top, insets, or clearance.
harmonyMotionWorktree.integrationReason: The route is unfinished and has no commit beyond the baseline commit; its search parity audit states that the current search implementation is not a qualified solution. No effect has been presented as completed and accepted for porting.

Explicit source-level enforcement of this manifest (28 checks). Not wired into builds, CI, contract tiers, or scopes; it does not assert message host placement.

scaffoldHeaderReceipt.contract: ReaderFixedHeaderHost reports the header content's own measured height. headerTop is a caller-owned margin outside that receipt; readers that clear from the scaffold top add it through this helper. The scaffold itself consumes only ReaderPageGeometry and no scalar top/inset/bottom API.

standardDirectoryPageHeader.messageHost: ReaderDirectoryRecoverySurface -> ReaderRecoveryNotice; owned by the existing message framework, not by this header spec

directoryHeader.measurementHost: ReaderPageScaffold.ets -> ReaderFixedHeaderHost.ets with topBarTop measurement key
directoryHeader.fallback: ReaderFullDirectory.pageGeometry(): content.startInset = max(0, topBarTop) + measuredHeader + panelGap

downloadHeader.scaffoldReceipt: intentionally unused; feeding it back into mainChromeOverflow would oscillate

appBar.scaffoldReceiptFormula: content height only; readerPresentedHeaderBottom(headerTop, headerHeight) = max(0, headerTop) + max(0, headerHeight)

detailHeader.contentStartFormula: ReaderPageGeometry.content.startInset = max(0, headerTop) + max(0, measuredHeader) + contentGap

standardDirectoryPageHeader.postMeasurementRule: list contentStart reads ReaderPageGeometry.content.startInset fed by standardMeasurements('bookDirectory:header'); the optional rules control and any expansion enter through measurement only. Message/recovery host placement is out of scope and unchanged.

directory.panelTopFormula: fallback: topBarTop + barHeight + panelGap; measured: headerMeasurements(headerMeasurementKey()) + panelGap

download.overflowRule: contentTop + contentBottom >= availableHeight moves topBar inline; its onAreaChange remains the single measurement owner

widthClass.rule: No page may redeclare a local 600 width comparison.

dynamicControlHeight.formula: ceil(max(0, baseHeight) + max(0, lineHeight) * max(0, readableScale(fontScale) - 1))

registry.rule: All durations/curves are registered; numeric animateTo/animation durations are forbidden. Reduce motion keeps the registered curve and sets duration to 0.

messageDisplay.rule: Call sites must use the constants. Message category, host, and lifecycle are unchanged.

appearanceActors.controlEndpoints: ReaderControlMotionGeometry.ts owns TopBar -8 / Dock +18 spatial samples

launchTimeline.beatOwner: All start times, actor durations, phase boundaries, 24vp dot size, and 4vp pause gap are named constants.
launchTimeline.exception: Pure TS sampler cannot import MotionSpec.ets across the ArkTS boundary.

ttsWaveform.rule: Decorative waveform clock; no inline timing numbers in the sampler.

pageSettlement.rule: Distance/velocity clock only; no second implicit tween.

forbiddenDuplicates.rule: APP_FLOATING_HEADER_BAR_HEIGHT, APP_HEADER_BAR_HEIGHT, and APP_FLOATING_HEADER_TOP_GAP may only be declared in ReaderHeaderMetrics.ts.
AppTopBar, PageBackBar, and ReaderPageShell must not reintroduce 52/58 as bar-height literals.
Bookshelf frameHeight and contentClearance must remain derived from barHeight + topInset + contentGap; do not hardcode 60 or 74 in header consumers.

Index.shelfHeaderHeight is the only stored bookshelf header measurement. BookshelfShell and BookshelfPage receive headerBottom and derive content start through headerBottom + contentGap / ReaderPageGeometry.
Search natural height must go through readerSearchHeaderHeight; keep the no-session, collapsed, and expanded branches lazy.
SearchPage must not reintroduce 44 filter min-height, 17 label line-height, or 4+4 summary/stats padding; consume SearchHeaderSpec.
Filter toggle timing may only come from MotionSpec entry search.filters.toggle; reduced motion zeroes duration but keeps the registered curve.
Standard-page content start must use readerStandardPageContentStart; ReaderStandardPage and ReaderMessagePreviewPage must not reintroduce 58 or 8 as local header/gap literals.
ReaderFullDirectory must consume DirectoryHeaderSpec for bar height, radius, control/menu row heights, top gap, panel gap, and menu gap; do not hardcode 54/42/24 or the 70/56 offsets.
LocalBookDetail must consume DetailHeaderSpec and headerMeasurements('detail:header') through pageGeometry(); do not reintroduce topInset + 76 or re-compose 8 + 52 + 16 locally.

BookDirectoryPage list content start must read standardGeometry().content.startInset fed by standardMeasurements('bookDirectory:header'); do not reintroduce 58+51 or standardHeaderHeight + 5, and the toolbar height must come from READER_DIRECTORY_TOOLBAR_HEIGHT. The header spec must not absorb message/recovery anchor fields.
ReaderPageScaffold must report the measured header height unchanged. Consumers clearing from the scaffold top add headerTop only through readerPresentedHeaderBottom.
SharedDownloadPage.measurements('download:header') stays the only header measurement; do not also wire the scaffold onHeaderHeightChange because the top bar relocates when chrome overflows.

ReaderPageScaffold must not regain headerTop/headerInset/footerInset/footerBottom/contentEndInset/frameInset scalar props. Hosts resolve ReaderPageGeometry and frameStyle; both are required, and the four host-owned preparation/reader exceptions use readerEmptyPageGeometry explicitly.
No numeric duration may appear in animateTo({...}) or animation({...}); register it in MotionSpec. duration: 0 immediate commits are allowed.
reduceMotion must be read through ReaderMotionPolicy (or a reactive @StorageLink/@Prop). The persisted key has one declaration and one duration/param collapse path.

MotionSpec stores only duration/curve/reduceMotion/contract id. Appearance panel actor fromY/delay values live in ReaderPanelMotionContract.ts; callers use panelActorTransition(id). Bookshelf view curves come from the shared contract.
READER_EXPANDED_MIN_WIDTH = 600 is the only width breakpoint declaration; pages use readerIsExpandedWidth.
ReaderPageSettlementTimeline consumes READER_PAGE_SETTLE_* bounds from ProductMotionTiming; do not inline 30/80/320/2.5 or add a second tween.
Buttons, form fields, choice rows, dialog actions, menu rows, and bounded-surface actions must grow through readerScaledControlHeight; do not re-implement the line-height growth formula.

Message display/dedupe windows may only be declared as READER_FEEDBACK_BRIEF_MS, READER_FEEDBACK_EXTENDED_MS, and READER_FEEDBACK_DEDUPE_MS in ReaderTransientFeedback.ts; call sites must not pass 2000/2200 literals.

No page may read deviceInfo.deviceType or accept a device-type boolean for layout. Layout capability comes from ReaderLayoutCapability.readerExpandedLayout(window metrics); manga persistent directory uses width/height only.
Pure TS launch and waveform samplers must consume named beat constants from ReaderSessionLaunchTimeline.ts / ReaderTtsWaveformModel.ts; no inline timing numbers.
Control composition coefficients (140/70/13/52/57/93/20 and adjacent actors) are owned by READER_CONTROL_MOTION_* in ReaderControlMotionGeometry.ts.
All ReaderPageScaffold call sites must name geometry; the four host-owned preparation/reader exceptions must explicitly call readerEmptyPageGeometry(). Full directory is no longer an exception.
readerAvailableWindowHeight, readerSurfaceMaxHeight, and readerDynamicSurfaceWidth must have production consumers; do not reimplement their arithmetic in download/import surfaces.
ReaderPageScaffold and ReaderPageShell must not regain route/header kinds, readingContentKind, or business color mappings. Features resolve ReaderFrameStyle.
ReaderPageGeometryInput.variant must stay deleted; it never participated in geometry resolution.

Standard pages use ReaderPageScrollHost; Search/Bookshelf/Download/SourceManagement/MultiSelect/SourceSwitchWindow consume ReaderScrollLayout offsets. ReaderDirectoryList/ReaderDirectoryNavigationList/ReaderDirectoryNavigationSurface consume the same layout while retaining native List/Grid and anchor ownership. ReaderControlSearchContent's normalized native end offset is a registered feature scroll exception; reading page-turn hosts remain native exceptions.
ReaderFullDirectory must resolve ReaderPageGeometry from headerMeasurements and use geometry.content.startInset for the panel top; no empty-geometry exception.

Every numeric .height() in TTS/RSS/Manga/ControlTTS must be classified in fixed-size-policy-20261025.json. Content text must use constraintSize or a dynamic resolver; the remaining heights are design-token/icon/touch/feature-panel only.

pureFunctionMatrix.doesNotProve: Native layout, first-frame paint, font measurement, device rendering, HAP packaging, or interaction.

portingInstructions: Read this manifest before porting structural UI or header geometry.
Use the baseline route for structure; do not copy the Harmony animation worktree's page copies.
Preserve one spec per surface, one measured owner, and consumer-only reads of resolved geometry.
Keep fallbacks as pure functions of the same spec values.
Port logical values through the target platform's native tokens and adapters; do not import Harmony-specific types.
When a completed Harmony effect needs different geometry, register a baseline contract request instead of letting the effect own geometry.
After editing any listed file, rerun the explicit checker with a rationale and update this manifest's fingerprints if the change is accepted.
